items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions David Butler as a guest at a table with Bill Robinson, but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not speak about any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: stage and screen who remembered Mr. Moseby for his past reputation of providing only the best of entertainers, and lavish amounts were notified in the throngs. Occupying the role of MC, Moseby has his old self again, the perfect host. Everyone felt themselves at home when Bill Robinson, from his ringside table, began calling up on some of the celebrities present who evidently were bent on keeping themselves unnoticed to stand up and take a bow.

" Mr. and Mrs. Bill Robinson had as their table guest Mr. David Butler, director of the 20th Century Fox film, The Littlest Rebel, in which Bill is featured. Among the other noticeables observed, Waller -- "
I think you dropped a line there.
